title: Good app but has things to be improved
body:
I've been using the app for a few months now and it's really cool to be able to track habits. I have the paid version and it works fine.

The only problem is if you want to edit a habit you lose all your data. So you basically can't change anything in your routine. That's an issue cause during our lives we do need to readjust habits sometimes. 

For example, I used to practice ukulele Monday to Friday, now I want to do it only at weekends cause I'm working on a new project. If I change it on the app, I will lose all the previous data. It's really annoying and I don't know what to do. 

Would also be great if you could add something that you don't usually do everyday, but you did that day. Example: I usually don't go to the gym at weekends, but this Saturday I decided to go. I can't add it to the app, so I can't tack that activity.

title: Best of all habit-tracking apps
body:
Productive is an elegant software that (finally) brings all of the best features of the different habit apps out there with its own flavour.

It has the simplicity and streak tracking capacity of Streaks.

It has the personality and self-care concerns of Fabulous (without the aggressive pricing practices)

It allows you to group habits by time of day, to schedule them in many ways and to track an habit multiple times a day. 

It has a pretty complete notification system.

It has timed/pomodoro type habits that can be paused and resumed at any time.

It’s overall pretty outstanding.

It also has an essential feature to me that many other habits app lack and unfortunately it’s its weakest piece: the Apple Watch app.

It gets the job done and allows you to check habits but it’s not at the same level with the rest of the app. 
Its Complications are not very useful, as the small ones don’t indicate any progress. 
It’s not possible to start a timed habit from the watch and the experience of using the app itself is a bit bland. There’s no sound feedback when you complete an app,  any animations to make things a bit more slick or any icons accompanying the habits. 

I think this is the aspect where Productive has the most room for improvement and they could learn a bit from Tangerine or Streaks.

But I still think it’s an unbelievable app, much better than the competition and I’m supporting the developer with my subscription hoping they will consider this feedback.
